issues.description: The problem statement names the helper that prepares a noisy |Y> resource state as `_make_y_state(...)` (leading underscore), but both the template and the solution define it as `make_y_state(...)` (no underscore). This mismatch can confuse students about which function to implement and may cause tests/autograders to fail if they expect the non-underscored name.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the name consistent across all materials. Either update the problem statement to refer to `make_y_state(...)` (no underscore) or update the template and solution to provide `_make_y_state(...)` (and keep a public alias `make_y_state` if desired). Ensure tests and examples use the same identifier.
